nodes.long_description:
1.Make a hydroelectric generator to run a wind turbine
2.Use the wind turbine to heat water with a water heater
3.Build a thermoelectric car
4. put the heated and cooled water into the tank of the thermoelectric car and drive the car 
Drive the car
nodes.short_description: Experiment with creating and using renewable energy in virtual reality using hydropower and wind power thermoelectric cells.
